title: eljut, hogyan jutok el: Asking How to Get Somewhere

sections.title: el- plus jut
sections.content: eljut ("to get to, to reach") adds the prefix el- ("away, to completion") to jut ("to get somewhere, to make it"). Use it with hogyan ("how") to ask the way: Hogyan jutok el a repülőtérre? ("How do I get to the airport?"). The destination takes whatever case it already needs — -ra/-re, -ba/-be or -hoz/-hez — exactly like with megy.

items.spanish: Hogyan jutok el a Nyugati pályaudvarra?
items.english: How do I get to Nyugati station?
The simplest way to get there is by bus.

items.spanish: Innen nem lehet könnyen eljutni a szállodához.
items.english: It's not easy to get to the hotel from here.

sections.content: oda ("there, to that place") is the handy short answer partner for eljut — Hogyan jutok el oda? ("How do I get there?") works for any destination you've already named, so you don't have to repeat it.
